Bug_Details:
Reported as "Printf Args" by printf-args.

This error is reported when the argument types to a printf method do not match the format string.

void stringInsteadOfInteger(PrintStream out) {    out.printf("Hello %d", "world");  }

Action: fix the mismatch between format string and argument types.
Bug_Explanation: The Printf Args bug occurs when the argument types to a printf method do not match the format string.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method. This method in turn calls the stringInsteadOfInteger() method which contains a printf statement with an integer format specifier but a string argument. The printf method throws an IllegalFormatConversionException when it encounters this mismatch.
